name: ExecutiveSummaryDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ExecutiveSummaryDashboard
summary: An executive summary dashboard: one page a lead reads to see how the quarter went. A page heading with the quarter Select and Export sits over a scorecard row of six StatTiles (revenue, monthly active users, net revenue retention, NPS, uptime and cost per request), each with its delta against last quarter and a Hint that defines it. Below, a trend grid of small multiples, one ChartCard per metric with a compact Chart (Area or Line) over the last 12 months and a Tag with the twelve-month change, shares one active index so hovering a month moves the crosshair on every card. A side column holds the goals, a Card of goal bars where each goal shows its label, a status Tag (On track, At risk, Off track), a Progress of current against target and both figures, and the commentary, a Card of Item rows with the author Avatar, role, date and the note itself. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the quarter loads, the tiles and charts render their own Skeleton and the goals and commentary hold Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A quarter with nothing reported. The tiles show a dash with no delta, every trend card keeps its box with an EmptyState that names the quarter and points to a later one, and the goals and commentary each say what fills them.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the quarter failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every trend card, the goals and the commentary keep their header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.
